notes.composition: multiset of the nonzero classes on the twenty faces of one carrier (carrier tier)
notes.history_sources: per-sweep compositions from the record files: L5 sweeps 0-600 (all), L6 0-80, L7 0-64, L8 0-4; after that the checkpoints (L6 every 50 to 500, L7 every 50 to 400, L8 every 50 to 300, L9 and L10 at 100, 200, 300)
notes.moves_between_carriers: EXACT: a face of a carrier changes only by a twist of one of its own 30 seams; glue seams carry screen plaquettes. Data: composition changes without an own-seam twist in that sweep = 0 at L5 (600 sweeps), L6 (80), L7 (64), L8 (4); total class content per carrier sums to 0 mod 6 on every checkpoint (CH). Content never moves to a neighbour.
notes.shape_symmetry: shapes up to the 60 proper rotations of the icosahedral template; a reflection maps class k to 6 - k, so the mirror image of a configuration of composition X is a configuration of the conjugate composition
notes.pair_correlation: g(r) = observed / expected pairs of carriers at angular distance r (units: mean spacing of adjacent cells), expected = same numbers placed at random on the carriers; error Poisson on the observed count; first shell (r < 0.5) is the carrier itself
